blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–After years of going home empty-handed, the Philippine women’s sepak takraw team finally had a medal to bring home from the Asian Games. Abegail Sinogbuhan, Jean Marie Sucalit and substitute Nelly Jay Saron settled for silver after losing to Vietnam, 15-8, 15-4, in Tuesday’s women’s doubles final at Mizuho Park Gymnasium. But the result still marked a breakthrough for Philippine women’s sepak takraw, which made its first Asian Games final en route to the best-ever finish for the country in the sport. “Mixed emotions because we really didn’t […]...
